info.title: Lunarr API
info.description: HTTP API for Lunarr catalog, playback, and administration.

get.summary: Get the signed-in user and profile preferences.
List personal API keys for the signed-in user.

post.summary: Create a personal API key.

patch.description: Partial update. Only fields present in the JSON body are changed. Returns the updated preference snapshot.

get.summary: List resumable movies and episodes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Get movies in continue watching.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Get episodes in continue watching.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Paginated personalized movie recommendations from recent watch history.
get.description: Ranks accessible unwatched movies by shared genres, keywords, cast, and directors with the caller's recent watches. Scoring: genres +3, keywords +2, people +1 per seed, using up to three recent seeds weighted 3/2/1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Browse movie rails and paged movie results.
get.description: Without `rail`, returns every browse rail in one response for home screens. Pass `rail` to fetch a single rail and avoid over-fetching on mobile clients.

parameters.name: rail
parameters.description: When set, returns only the requested rail(s). Comma-separate multiple rails. Each rail also returns a matching `*Page` object (for example `continueWatchingPage`, `allPage`). Omit for the full bundled response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Get full movie details.
get.description: Returns the complete movie payload including cast. Mobile and third-party clients should prefer GET /api/movies/{id}/overview and GET /api/movies/{id}/credits for smaller lazy-loaded responses.

get.summary: Get movie metadata, files, and progress without cast.
Get cast, directors, and writers for a movie.
get.description: Lazy-load people credits for the movie landing screen.

get.summary: List movies similar to a title in the caller's accessible library.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

post.summary: Mark or unmark a movie as watched.
Refresh metadata for a single movie.

get.summary: Search TMDb candidates to manually match a movie.
get.description: Accepts a TMDb movie URL or ID (resolved into a single candidate) or a text query searched against TMDb. Admin only.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: TMDb URL, TMDb ID, or a text search query.

post.summary: Manually match a movie to a TMDb entry chosen by an admin.
post.description: Points the movie at the given TMDb movie ID and marks the match as manual so future scans and refreshes keep it. Admin only.

delete.summary: Revert a movie to automatic TMDb matching.
delete.description: Clears the manual match flag and immediately re-matches the movie by filename. Returns 200 even when the automatic re-match finds nothing: the flag is cleared and the movie keeps its current metadata until the next scheduled refresh. Admin only.

get.summary: Browse show rails and paged show results.
get.description: Without `rail`, returns every browse rail in one response for home screens. Pass `rail` to fetch a single rail and avoid over-fetching on mobile clients.

parameters.name: rail
parameters.description: When set, returns only the requested rail(s). Comma-separate multiple rails. Episode rails return `EpisodeSummary` items, and show rails return `ShowSummary` items. Each rail also returns a matching `*Page` object. Omit for the full bundled response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

get.summary: Paginated personalized show recommendations from recent episode watch history.
get.description: Ranks accessible unwatched shows by shared genres, keywords, cast, and creators with the caller's recent episode watches. Scoring: genres +3, keywords +2, people +1 per seed, using up to three recent show seeds weighted 3/2/1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per rail or continue section. Default 24. Clamped to 200.

parameters.name: moviesPage
parameters.description: Page number for the person's movie credits.

parameters.name: showsPage

get.summary: List scan jobs, playback sessions, and job summaries.
get.description: Returns the latest scan jobs and playback sessions with summary counts. Scan error details are loaded separately from GET /api/jobs/{id}/errors.

get.summary: List recent scan errors for a job.
get.description: Returns the newest scan errors for the given scan job, up to 100 rows. Job rows from GET /api/jobs include errors_count for the total recorded during the run.

get.summary: Get full show details with every season and episode.
get.description: Returns the complete show tree. Mobile and third-party clients should prefer GET /api/shows/{id}/overview and GET /api/shows/{id}/seasons/{seasonId} for smaller payloads.

get.summary: Get show metadata and season list without episode details.
Get cast and creators for a show.
get.description: Lazy-load people credits for the show landing screen. Mirrors TMDb aggregate credits split into cast and show creators.

get.summary: Search TMDb candidates to manually match a show.
get.description: Accepts a TMDb show URL or ID (resolved into a single candidate) or a text query searched against TMDb. Admin only.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: TMDb URL, TMDb ID, or a text search query.

post.summary: Manually match a show to a TMDb entry chosen by an admin.
post.description: Points the show and its seasons at the given TMDb show ID and marks the match as manual so future scans and refreshes keep it. Admin only.

delete.summary: Revert a show to automatic TMDb matching.
delete.description: Clears the manual match flag and immediately re-matches the show and its seasons by title. Returns 200 even when the automatic re-match finds nothing or the show has no seasons: the flag is cleared and the show keeps its current metadata until the next scheduled refresh. Admin only.

post.summary: Mark or unmark a season as watched.

get.summary: Get one season with episodes and watch progress.
get.description: seasonId accepts the season UUID or season number (for example 1). Returns a lightweight season tab list for navigation.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by Better Auth.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Lunarr API key created from the profile API key screen.

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code for this occurrence.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

setupComplete.description: True after the first admin account has been created during setup.

name.description: Display name for the API key. Empty or omitted defaults to 'Mobile app'.

expiresIn.description: Lifetime of the key in seconds. Null or omitted creates a non-expiring key.

preferredAudioLanguage.description: Preferred audio language as an ISO-639-2 code. Empty string clears the preference.

preferredSubtitleLanguage.description: Preferred subtitle language as an ISO-639-2 code. Empty string clears the preference.

continueMaxAgeDays.description: Hide idle in-progress items from Continue rails after this many days. 0 disables staleness filtering.

segmentSkipEnabled.description: Enable intro, recap, and credits skip prompts during playback.

segmentSkipAutomatic.description: When segment skip is enabled, skip matching segments automatically instead of showing a button.

enabled.description: Whether intro, recap, and credits skip is enabled.

automatic.description: When enabled, skip matching segments automatically instead of showing a button.

MovieDetailRecord.description: Movie metadata record with database snake_case field names.

MovieBrowseRailResponse.description: Partial browse payload returned when `rail` is set on GET /api/movies.

ShowBrowseRailResponse.description: Partial browse payload returned when `rail` is set on GET /api/shows.

segments.description: Intro, recap, and credits windows from IntroDB. Empty when segmentSkip.enabled is false or lookup data is unavailable.

LibraryInput.description: Create or update library payload. Accepted for both JSON and form-data submissions. Unknown fields are ignored. Boolean/numeric values may be submitted as strings (e.g. 'true', '1').

source.description: Library storage source. Defaults to 'local' when omitted.

kind.description: Media kind. Defaults to 'movie' on create when omitted.

path.description: Absolute local path. Required for local libraries.

host.description: Remote host. Required for sftp and webdav libraries.

port.description: Remote port. Defaults to 22 for sftp and 443 for webdav.

username.description: Remote username. Required for sftp and webdav.

password.description: Remote password. Required on create for sftp and webdav.

root.description: Root directory on the remote server.

secure.description: Use HTTPS for webdav. May also be sent as 'useHttps' or 'use_https'. Defaults to true.

operationTimeoutMs.description: Remote operation timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000.

watchEnabled.description: Enable filesystem watching. May also be sent as 'watch_enabled'. Default true.

scanIntervalMinutes.description: Automatic scan interval in minutes. May also be sent as 'scan_interval_minutes'. Null disables scheduled scans.

ScanStartResponse.description: Scan job identifier returned when a library scan starts or reuses an active job.

resolved.description: True when the query was a TMDb URL or ID resolved into a single candidate.

mediaItemId.description: Media item identifier after the match, which can change when items are merged. Null when the revert found no automatic match and the item was replaced by local items.

ServerStatus.description: Server status summary returned by GET /api/settings.

playbackCacheEntries.description: Number of shared HLS segment cache entries on disk.

playbackCacheBytes.description: Total bytes used by shared HLS segment cache entries.

playbackCacheActiveRefs.description: Sum of playback session reference counts across cache entries.

playbackCacheIdleEntries.description: Number of shared HLS cache entries with no active playback session refs.

movieMetadataStalenessDays.description: Scheduled movie metadata staleness window in days. Default 30. Use 0 to refresh all movies each run.

tvMetadataStalenessDays.description: Scheduled TV metadata staleness window in days. Default 14. Use 0 to refresh all seasons each run.

encodeAheadSegmentCount.description: Request-driven HLS encode-ahead window in segments beyond the requested segment. Default 4.

playbackCacheTtlHours.description: Idle TTL for unreferenced shared HLS cache entries, in hours. Default 24. Combined with LRU eviction against playbackSessionArtifactMaxBytes.

movieMetadataRefreshIntervalHours.description: Scheduled movie metadata refresh interval, in whole hours. Null or 0 disables scheduled refresh.

tvMetadataRefreshIntervalHours.description: Scheduled TV metadata refresh interval, in whole hours. Null or 0 disables scheduled refresh.

movieMetadataStalenessDays.description: On scheduled movie metadata refresh, skip movies updated within this window. Default 30. Use 0 to refresh all movies each run.

tvMetadataStalenessDays.description: On scheduled TV metadata refresh, skip seasons updated within this window. Default 14. Use 0 to refresh all seasons each run.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Hardware acceleration mode. Unsupported values are treated as 'off'.

transcodeQualityPreset.description: Transcode quality preset. Unsupported values fall back to 'auto'.

playbackSessionArtifactMaxBytes.description: Combined byte limit for playback-sessions playlists and playback-cache segments. Invalid values fall back to the default.

encodeAheadSegmentCount.description: Request-driven HLS encode-ahead window in segments.

playbackCacheTtlHours.description: Idle TTL for unreferenced shared HLS cache entries, in hours. Values at or below 0 are ignored.

SettingsActionResponse.description: Settings action result. Synchronous actions use PlaybackArtifactsCleanupResponse or TmdbTestResponse. Job actions return job metadata.

libraries.description: Number of libraries queued for scanning.

jobIds.description: Scan job identifiers started or reused for each library.

SettingsJobStartResponse.description: Result of metadata refresh or media probe repair actions that enqueue a background job.

existing.description: Whether an active job was reused instead of creating a new one.

cacheRemoved.description: Idle shared HLS cache entries removed.

sessionsRemoved.description: Distinct playback sessions whose artifacts were cleaned.
